$janet.$comment: Not JSON Schema. Read by scripts/Test-OutputContracts.ps1, which is the point of the file living here rather than being generated from the return type.
$janet.$comment.contractField: The envelope stamps 'contract' and the gate cross-checks it against the number above, so code and schema cannot drift apart in either direction.
$janet.$comment.metadataValues: No field carries a blob's metadata value. Metadata keys decide what is dropped, but the values (a campaign title, for one) are never copied into this envelope.
$janet.$comment.everyKey: Every key is always present; a value that does not apply is null rather than absent.

contract.description: Bumped only by a format change. An engine change that moves this number is a mistake in one direction; a format change that does not is a mistake in the other.

mode.description: 'refresh': delete the target client's in-scope data, then copy the source's live data over. 'clear': delete only; the source is not read.

pair.description: The name of the spec's source/target pair this plan is for.

spec.description: The path of the spec file, as the caller passed it.

source.description: Where a refresh reads from. Never written.

target.description: Where the plan deletes and writes: the staging copy.

delete.description: What apply would remove from the target before copying: the target client's in-scope blobs that a copying rule matches, and its entities in each listed table.

byRule.description: The same deletions counted per rule (a blob rule's match text or a table's name), sorted by rule.

rule.description: A blob rule's match text, or a table name.

count.description: How many deletions that rule accounts for.

copy.description: What apply would copy from the source to the target. Zero everywhere in clear mode.

bytes.description: Total length of those blobs in bytes.

byRule.description: The same copies counted per rule, sorted by rule.

rule.description: A blob rule's match text, or a table name.

count.description: How many copies that rule accounts for.

bytes.description: Bytes those copies carry; zero for a table.

dropped.description: Source items a refresh leaves out as dead, so they are neither copied nor a reason to block.

byReason.description: The same drops counted per reason, sorted by reason.

reason.description: Why it was dropped: the metadata key a rule's dropIfMetadata names (e.g. 'undone', a deleted save), or 'noLiveSave' when the save it belongs to is missing or itself dropped (keepIfLive).

count.description: How many items were dropped for that reason.

unmatched.description: Source blobs in scope that no rule matches. Any of them blocks apply: add a rule, or a rule with copy false.

count.description: How many source blobs match no rule.

names.description: Their names, sorted, at most the first 100.
Null unless the caller passed rule. Then the names that one rule would delete and copy: blob names, or 'partitionKey/rowKey' for an entity. Never a metadata value.

readyToApply.description: True when blockers is empty. Apply writes nothing while this is false.

blockers.description: Why apply would refuse: unmatched source blobs, and a container or table that does not exist (Janet never creates them; they belong to Bicep and its role scopes).

planHash.description: SHA-256 (lower-case hex) over the mode, the pair, both ends and every operation with its ETag, so any change that alters what apply would do makes apply stale. storage_copy_apply must be given this value and recomputes it; any change in between makes apply stale.

client.description: The client whose data this end holds: it fills {client} in container names, prefixes and partition keys.

delete.description: Names that rule would delete from the target, sorted.

items.description: A blob name, or 'partitionKey/rowKey' for an entity.

copy.description: Names that rule would write to the target, sorted; blobs under their target names.

items.description: A blob name, or 'partitionKey/rowKey' for an entity.
